title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, Web UI, and MCP server to find code patterns and reusable components across a user's portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend using sentence-transformers for embeddings and SQLite-vec for vector storage. FastAPI serves the REST API. The web frontend is static HTML/JS consuming JSON exports. AWS Lambda handles OAuth. GitHub Actions automate weekly reindexing.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or use the CLI/MCP server to search your codebase semantically.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF weighting
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Auto-generated capability clusters for repo grouping
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Static web UI with shareable URLs and collections
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
